name: Aminotadalafil
summary: An analogue of tadafinil, better known as Cialis (Viagra). Infamous for being missold in the 'Alpha Male' sexual enhancement supplement.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: Like tadalafil, it is thought to block the enzyme PDE5. Blocking it lets a signalling molecule build up in blood vessel walls, which relaxes them and increases blood flow.
pharmacology.zh: 和他達拉非一樣，一般認為它會阻斷 PDE5 酵素。阻斷後，血管壁中的一種訊號分子會累積，使血管放鬆並增加血流。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和他达拉非一样，一般认为它会阻断 PDE5 酵素。阻断后，血管壁中的一种信号分子会累积，使血管放松并增加血流。

uses.en: It has no approved medical use. It has mainly been found as an undeclared ingredient in supplements sold for erectile problems.
uses.zh: 它沒有核准的醫療用途，主要是在號稱改善勃起問題的保健食品中被發現為未標示成分。
uses.zhHans: 它没有核准的医疗用途，主要是在号称改善勃起问题的保健食品中被发现为未标示成分。

sideEffects.en: It has not been tested properly in people. Drugs of its class can cause headache, flushing, indigestion, a stuffy nose, back pain and visual disturbance, and can drop blood pressure sharply.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體經過適當測試。同類藥物可能造成頭痛、臉部潮紅、消化不良、鼻塞、背痛與視覺異常，也可能使血壓驟降。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体经过适当测试。同类药物可能造成头痛、脸部潮红、消化不良、鼻塞、背痛与视觉异常，也可能使血压骤降。

fact.en: It is a close copy of tadalafil, sold as Cialis. Because it is not an approved medicine, it has turned up undeclared in supplements sold as natural sexual enhancers.
fact.zh: 它是他達拉非（商品名 Cialis）的近似複製品。由於它不是核准藥物，曾未標示地出現在號稱天然壯陽的保健食品中。
fact.zhHans: 它是他达拉非（商品名 Cialis）的近似拷贝品。由于它不是核准药物，曾未标示地出现在号称天然壮阳的保健食品中。
